summary: A self-hosted platform for personal services and projects.
contribution: Set up an Ubuntu container host on repurposed hardware and operate personal services using Docker Compose and reverse proxying.

decisions.title: Make deployment repeatable

architecture.description: Incoming requests reach Caddy on the Ubuntu host and are routed to Docker services, including Nginx serving this portfolio. Docker Compose describes the services.

flowchart LR
        internet[Internet] --> caddy[Caddy reverse proxy]
        subgraph host[Ubuntu host]

          compose[Docker Compose] -. configures .-> nginx
          compose -. configures .-> services
        end

name: HomeLab Platform
purpose: Repurpose spare hardware into an Ubuntu-based container host for personal services and portfolio projects, with Docker Compose, reverse proxying, and hands-on ownership of deployment and operations.
coreStory: My ageing laptop struggled to run Minecraft and its server together. When a spare PC became available at home, I configured an Ubuntu Server virtual machine to host my software in the background.

I operate it as a Docker and Nginx machine for the current Minecraft server and other personal services, with Compose and reverse proxying for deployment. The GPU-equipped PC also hosted the SmartHomeBridge detection experiment. It gives me hands-on responsibility for configuring and running my own services.
